title: maos.audit-bundle.v1
description: Sealed export bundle for the MAOS audit trail. Canonical byte serialization for signing uses JSON with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace (serde_json sorted_keys serializer). The Ed25519 signature covers sha256(canonical_bundle_bytes) where canonical_bundle_bytes is the sorted-key, no-whitespace JSON encoding of all fields except signature_block. ENFORCED by the `check-j1-two-host-signed-run` gate (j1-crosshost-2c AC2.6): before that this file was a FALSE SPECIFICATION -- `additionalProperties: false` while omitting three fields the struct emitted, read by no machine. Every optional field below is `skip_serializing_if` in `crates/maos-audit/src/sealed_export.rs`, so a bundle that omits it stays byte-identical to the pre-9.4b surface.

payload.description: stored payload_redacted bytes decoded as UTF-8; omitted when empty

redaction.description: populated ONLY by query_with_redaction(); omitted otherwise

region.description: Story 9.4b AC-5 -- canonical (ascii-v1) jurisdiction tag. When present the signing key is HKDF-derived from it, so tampering it breaks verification (R-RG4'). Omitted for pre-region bundles.

host.description: j1-crosshost-2c AC2.1 -- host discriminator, covered by the signature. An ANTI-FORGERY control, not a label: both halves of a two-host run carry the same frame_ids and are otherwise indistinguishable. It proves TWO KEYED IDENTITIES SIGNED -- not two machines, two processes, or two operators. Omitted for single-host bundles, which therefore stay byte-identical.
